title: LLY Ricci Reweighting in Stochastic Block Models: Uniform Curvature Concentration and Finite-Horizon Tracking
summary: We study curvature-driven edge reweighting for community recovery in the balanced two-block stochastic block model. Given a graph G with initial weights equal to the adjacency matrix, we iteratively update edge weights using Lin-Lu-Yau (Ollivier-type) Ricci curvature, while all transportation costs are computed in the unweighted graph metric. In a moderate-density regime we prove uniform concentration of edge curvatures and show that a single Ricci reweighting step produces a two-level weighting that amplifies within-block connectivity relative to across-block connectivity.
